newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs take knock but supported at 129.35.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs take knock but supported at 129.35.

text.p: June BTP futures on LIFFE have been hit by fundamental factors but are well supported on the charts around 129.30,35 on Tuesday, analysts said.

"We've seen a bit of a weak start which is to be expected given the resurgence of some doubts about EMU yesterday on the back of the EU Commission's report," Louise Jones, fixed income analyst at Technical Data in London.

A Commission report on Monday suggested that many of the measures Italy has taken to cut its budget deficit to qualify for European Economic and Monetary Union were not sustainable. BTPs were quoted at 129.61, down 11 basis points at 0759 GMT.
Jones said support around 129.30,35 came from interday support and resistance levels, with the May 7 high coming in at 129.35.
"I can't see a move below there this morning because of the prospect of U.S. data this afternoon," Jones said.
If the data, including April retail sales, are unsupportive, the next level down was Monday's low at 128.87, which should hold any further decline.
Andy Anderson, manager of strategic trading at Fuji Bank in London, also expected the contract to drift off a little with resistance coming in strong at Friday's high of 129.88.
In the weeks ahead however, the contract could push it's way back up to the old highs at 131.76.
At the short end, June Eurolire on LIFFE were quoted unchanged at 93.25.
Technical analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in London, said the contract was still in a range from 93.16 to 93.30 with divergent indicators.
"The apparent failure above 93.29 makes and extension higher (to 93.38) even less likely, and points to a retreat to an uptrending channel," they said in a research note.
That channel comes in around 93.21 this session.
